cameras.name: Z CAM E2-F6
cameras.notes: Original E2-F6 (full frame 6K, model E1901), FW 0.98 manual. Internal codecs: H.264 / H.265 / ZRAW (manual v0.4) plus ProRes 422 Proxy/LT/422/HQ (added in later firmware; FW 0.98.0 release coverage says ProRes 422 in all resolution/fps modes; Z CAM wiki encoder table lists ProRes HQ as 'NA' at 6K - check camera). Project fps: 23.98/24/25/29.97 for Open Gate/6K DCI/6K UHD/5K 4:3/5K 6:5/4K DCI 3:2; plus 50/59.94 for 6K 2.4:1/5K DCI/5K/4K/S16/FHD; higher rates via VFR (maxfps). 2.8K (2868x1512) mode listed in manual without fps, omitted. ProRes RAW/BRAW only to external recorders over HDMI (not included). Not the E2-F6 Pro (separate camera, internal ProRes RAW, ZBlade). Storage CFast 2.0 / USB SSD.

codecs.name: ProRes 422 HQ
codecs.ref: ESTIMATE. Z CAM publishes no per-flavour ProRes data rate (spec pages only say 'ProRes, H.265 & H.264: up to 300 Mbps' for S6, which cannot be right for ProRes HQ at 6K). bpp from Apple ProRes White Paper target ProRes 422 HQ 1920x1080 29.97p = 220 Mb/s (bpp = Mbps*1e6/(1920*1080*29.97)). ProRes is MOV only (Z CAM wiki intro.md). ProRes added to E2 flagship models in firmware after 0.93; FW 0.98.0 (CineD) enables ProRes 422 for all resolution/frame-rate modes. Max fps per flavour varies (wiki intro.md table, e.g. FHD up to 120, 4K up to 50-75); HQ at 6K marked NA in wiki table.
